lead_ceremony:
Yewheather leaves to speak with StarClan. He closes his eyes and is immediately surrounded by his loved ones, friends, and Clanmates who have passed on. Stars shine throughout their pelts, and their eyes are warm as they greet the new leader.

Yewheather notices Streamtrot's pleased expression as she trots up. She gives a life for friendship and whispers that RiverClan is surely in good paws.

Rabbitspark dips his head in greeting. Energy surges through Yewheather's pelt as he receives a life for instincts. He reassures Yewheather that he is almost done.

Splinterfang steps forward to give Yewheather a life for strength. Yewheather grits his teeth as the life rushes into him.

Stars flicker in Shinespot's fur and pride lights his friendly gaze. He gives Yewheather a life for certainty, the sensation like a warm nest surrounded by loved ones.

Yewheather squares his shoulders, standing up as straight as he can, as Jaggedsplash approaches. Jaggedsplash's whiskers twitch in amusement as he gives a life for confidence.

Eaglekit bounds up to the new leader, reaching up on her hind legs to give him a new life for perspective. She flicks her tail and heads back to make room for the next cat.

Tortellini walks up to Yewheather, offering a life for clear judgment. She smiles and states that the Clan will do well under Yewheather's leadership.

Yarrow approaches, dipping her head in greeting. "I give you a life for wisdom." She meows, before slipping back into the crowd.

Finally, Silverstar steps forward. There is pride in his gaze as he stares into Yewheather's eyes. He gives a life for knowing when to fight and when to choose peace.

Silverstar hails Yewheather by his new name, Yewstar, telling him that his old life is no more. He is granted guardianship of RiverClan, and is told to use his new power wisely. The group of starry cats yowls Yewstar's name in support. Yewstar wakes up feeling a new strength within his body and knows that he is now ready to lead the Clan.
